title: Tech Note: Intro to HTTPRequest: Asynchronous API Requests with Callbacks
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Art Institute of Chicago public API demo

historical_commentary.text: 4D.HTTPRequest remains the current, recommended way to perform outbound HTTP calls in 4D; the classic HTTP Request/HTTP Get commands still exist for backward compatibility but 4D's own documentation and sample code have continued to favor the class-based, async/callback approach introduced here. Nothing in later 4D releases has superseded this API — it is a genuine, durable upgrade, not a stopgap.
related_updates: Still fully valid; 4D.HTTPRequest remains the recommended networking API over the legacy HTTP Request/HTTP Get commands.
